name: Observability & Monitoring (OTel + Metrics + Logs + Tracing)
description: Production-grade observability for RawDrive services using OpenTelemetry for traces/metrics/logs, Prometheus/Grafana for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo/Jaeger for traces, and Alertmanager for alerting. Enforces consistent correlation and tenant-safe metadata.
goals: End-to-end tracing for user and public portal requests with correlation IDs.
High-signal metrics and dashboards aligned to SLOs.
Actionable alerts with runbook links and escalation paths.
nonGoals: Replacing incident management tooling (PagerDuty/Opsgenie) if adopted later.
Storing raw media content in logs/traces.

rules: All telemetry MUST include workspace_id when available, but never for unauthenticated public requests unless resolved safely via share link.
Never emit PII (emails/phones/access codes) as labels/tags; use hashes or omit.
High-cardinality IDs (asset_id, share_token) must not be used as metric labels; allowed only in logs/traces with sampling.

actors.name: Platform Admin
actors.description: Owns monitoring, alerting, SLOs, incident response.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Services emit telemetry; collectors and backends store/process.

workflows.name: Request Telemetry Standards
steps: Assign/request correlation id (x-request-id) at edge/gateway; propagate downstream.
Create root span per request and add attributes: service.name, http.route, http.method.
Attach workspace_id only after authentication or secure share-link resolution.
Record errors with stable error codes; avoid raw stack traces in user-facing responses.
Export via OTel Collector to Prometheus/Loki/Tempo backends.

controls: PII scrubbing in logs; structured logging with allowlisted fields.
Sampling policies for high-volume public portal traffic.
Retention policies: logs/traces retained per environment and compliance requirements.

logs: Structured JSON logs with request_id, workspace_id (when safe), actor_type
Audit logs are separate stream with longer retention
alerts: SLO burn rate alerts for key routes
Queue backlog and job failure spikes

acceptanceTests: Every API response includes x-request-id and is searchable in logs.
Metrics do not include high-cardinality IDs as labels.
workspace_id is only present in telemetry after auth or safe share-link resolution.
/metrics is inaccessible from the public internet.
